snapshot.thesis: France's leading specialist property portal is rebuilding itself as a smaller, French-run, field-facing business under KKR/CPP ownership, after cutting 28.5% of its staff, while Leboncoin, Bien'ici and newcomer Idealista compete for the same agency budgets.

business.title: Turning a cut, re-localised SeLoger back into the agencies' first-choice portal before rivals and owners lose patience

rows.label: Model
rows.text: Free search for consumers; paid listing-diffusion and visibility packages (Ancien, Néo, Delta, Luxury, Bureaux & Commerces, plus boosts such as Duo Prime and Top Position) sold to agencies, developers and luxury specialists. Private sellers list free since 2023. Referral placements (mortgage, insurance, moving) add a secondary stream. No revenue or margin is published.

rows.label: Stage
rows.text: **Transformation.** A mature 1989-born brand, owned since April 2025 through AVIV by KKR and CPP Investments, two job plans in two years (90 roles in 2024, 275 of 964 in 2026), a new local tech team and a fresh regional acquisition.

rows.label: Priorities
rows.text: Re-regionalise sales and bring product, marketing and support close to agencies; turn salespeople into performance consultants; ship product (AI search, My SeLoger Pro, 75+ innovations planned for H1 2026); spend 30% more on advertising; integrate Ouest-France Immo with joint offers by end-2026.

rows.label: Pressure
rows.text: Leboncoin has roughly double SeLoger's traffic; Bien'ici grew visits 14% in 2025; Idealista entered France on 10 Sep 2026. Transactions fell from 1.2m (2021) to 778k (2023) and recovered more slowly than hoped. Some agency clients reportedly dispute billing and cancellations.

strengths: Leading 100%-real-estate portal in France, with over 33% listings share in Île-de-France (Yanport, third-party).
Brand family covering new-build, luxury, commercial and valuation (Meilleurs Agents), sold to 20,000 partner agencies.
Listings database legally defended: three rulings against Jinka between Dec 2025 and Jul 2026.
weaknesses: Roughly half of Leboncoin's traffic and 14.6% of private-seller listings versus 70.6%.
Engineering bench cut hard: about 80% of the 275 roles removed in 2026 were developers and engineers.
CEO himself says the company lost its 'ADN de commerçant'; senior-management rating on Glassdoor is 2.6/5.
opportunities: Regional consolidation: Ouest-France Immo gives 75–80% of listings in Brittany, Pays de la Loire and Normandy.
Market recovery from the 2023 low of 778k transactions.
AI natural-language search (launched Sep 2026) as a differentiator while rivals catch up.
threats: Idealista's French launch, led by a former Leboncoin Immobilier executive.
Agency churn and billing disputes in a subscription model.
Political uncertainty the company itself flags: government instability, sovereign debt, unclear housing policy.

dynamics.title: French field culture regains control, but money and the last word sit in Berlin and with the owners

items.text: SeLoger has had four owner regimes: founders, a Paris listing (2006), Axel Springer (2011) and, since April 2025, KKR and CPP via AVIV. Employees experienced the AVIV era as cost pressure: one former sales executive alleges pay fell sharply after the Meilleurs Agents takeover. That is a single unverified review.

AVIV built a shared European listings platform and a CCO Europe role (2023–Jan 2025), then in 2026 ended the platform project and moved tech and product back to France. Staff have lived through both directions inside three years.

Customers, brands, the sales force and now engineering sit in France. Budget, group functions and owner reporting sit in Berlin and with KKR/CPP. France's share of AVIV revenue is not published, so its negotiating weight is unknown.

Capron sets a commercial, field-first tone ('ADN de commerçant', consultants not subscription sellers). Pravdivy brings a marketplace-operator background built at Avito. The owners bring PE return discipline. Glassdoor approval is low at both levels: 2.6/5 for SeLoger senior management and 2.1/5 for AVIV.

Capron said all teams 'will be local and speak French', which implies the previous group-run teams often worked in English. AVIV recruits in English and opens some roles to Paris or Berlin interchangeably.

dynamics.note: France and the Avito-shaped leadership style cluster on high-context, hierarchical and relationship-based working. Germany and the US-led investor style cluster on low-context and task-based working. The investor style is the outlier on persuading: it wants applications first, while the other three want the reasoning first.

culture.dimensionsTitle: Where friction is most likely, by Meyer dimension

views.fr: Persuasion starts with the principle and the logic; a conclusion without reasoning feels unearned.
views.de: Reasoning and thorough analysis are expected before recommendations.
views.ru: Theory and reasoning carry weight, then a strong conclusion.
views.us: Lead with the recommendation and the numbers; theory comes later, if at all.

dimensions.scene: At an owner or AVIV business review, the France team opens with why the regional model fits French agencies. The investor side wants leads per agency, churn and the payback of the extra 30% ad spend on page one.
dimensions.helps: Prepare two versions of every case: answer-first for owners, reasoning-first for French teams and staff representatives.

views.fr: The boss is expected to set direction visibly; hierarchy is real even when the tone is informal.
views.de: Moderate hierarchy; expertise and process carry authority.
views.ru: Strong hierarchy; the leader is expected to decide and to be seen deciding.
views.us: Fairly egalitarian; leaders are expected to be accessible and to empower.

dimensions.scene: After the PSE, a Paris engineering manager waits for the new CTO to set priorities before re-planning. Group colleagues used to self-organising squads read the pause as passivity.
dimensions.helps: Give French teams explicit direction from a named leader, and tell group colleagues who owns which decision now.

views.fr: Trust grows through relationships and time spent together, including lunches and regional events.
views.de: Trust comes from reliable, competent work delivered as promised.
views.ru: Trust is personal and built over time; formal processes alone do not create it.
views.us: Trust is earned through delivery and can be built and dropped quickly.

dimensions.scene: Integrating Ouest-France Immo, the 35 Rennes staff and the region's agencies judge SeLoger by who shows up in person. A group integration plan run by video and dashboards can look cold.
dimensions.helps: Invest early face time in Rennes and with regional agencies, while showing Berlin and the owners delivery milestones.

dimensions.tension: French teams ↔ group and investor communications

views.fr: Much is implied; people read between the lines and value nuance.
views.de: Explicit, precise and written; repetition is normal.
views.ru: High-context; meaning sits in relationships and what is left unsaid.
views.us: Very explicit; say it, then repeat it in writing.

dimensions.scene: A terse English-language group note ends the shared listings platform. French engineers who survived the PSE read job risk into what it leaves out.
dimensions.helps: Re-explain group messages in French, in person, and state explicitly what does not change.

dimensions.tension: Group consensus processes ↔ France and leadership top-down habits

views.fr: The senior person decides after debate; decisions can be revisited.
views.de: Consensus is built slowly; once made, decisions stick.
views.ru: Decisions come from the top and quickly.
views.us: One owner decides fast; adjustment follows.

dimensions.scene: Pricing the joint SeLoger–Ouest-France Immo offers before end-2026 needs a call from Capron. Group finance may expect a longer alignment loop.
dimensions.helps: Agree up front who decides and who is only consulted; record the decision and the date.

dimensions.tension: Direct French, German and Avito-shaped feedback ↔ more cushioned investor style

views.fr: Criticism is fairly direct, often framed intellectually.
views.ru: Very direct, including in front of others.
views.us: Positive framing first, criticism wrapped in encouragement.

dimensions.scene: In a post-PSE performance review, a French manager critiques a team's delivery bluntly. Teams already hurt by two job plans hear it as a signal of the next cut.
dimensions.helps: Keep feedback direct on the work, and say explicitly whether a person's role is at risk.

dimensions.tension: German and investor timelines ↔ French consultation rhythm

views.fr: Plans flex; legal consultation and negotiation set the real pace.

dimensions.scene: A group integration deadline meets French information-consultation steps. The 2026 PSE took several weeks of negotiation, and it moved the outcome from 354 to 275 roles.
dimensions.helps: Build consultation steps into the critical path and tell the owners the real date early.

dimensions.tension: Open French debate ↔ investor preference for alignment

views.fr: Open disagreement is normal and does not harm the relationship.
views.ru: Disagreement can be open and sharp.
views.us: Moderate; disagreement is softened to keep momentum.

dimensions.scene: In the comité de direction, managers challenge the localisation plan hard. That is a normal sign of engagement, not resistance.
dimensions.helps: Invite challenge explicitly, then close with a clear decision.

joining.eyebrow: For an executive joining from outside France
joining.title: What to expect in the first six months

items.title: French is the operating language again
items.text: Capron has said all teams will be local and French-speaking. Expect leadership meetings, CSE dialogue and agency visits in French.

items.title: Staff representatives are a standing counterpart
items.text: The 2026 PSE was negotiated over weeks and cut from 354 to 275 roles. Any reorganisation, including small ones, needs early consultation.

items.title: Teams are tired of change
items.text: Two job plans in two years and reviews citing 'constant change' mean people will judge you on stability and follow-through before vision.

items.title: Reasoning before asks
items.text: French colleagues expect to hear why before what. A one-slide answer may land in Berlin but not in Paris.

items.title: The regions count
items.text: The strategy is re-regionalisation. Visiting agencies outside Paris and in Rennes is part of the job, not a courtesy.

items.title: Two reporting worlds
items.text: Paris decides more than it did in 2025, but budgets and owner reviews run through Berlin. Learn both rhythms early.

hiring.title: Assessing cultural adaptability

items.title: Evidence of bridging
items.text: Look for roles where the candidate represented a country unit to a foreign headquarters or sponsor and brought back decisions.

items.title: References from both sides
items.text: Take one reference from a French direct report or staff-representative counterpart and one from a group or owner-side stakeholder.

items.title: Explicit language requirement
items.text: Professional French and English are likely needed. Validate with the client and state it as a skill requirement.

items.title: Onboarding pairing
items.text: Pair a newcomer with a long-tenured insider, such as CTO Valentin Stackler (nine years in the company), for context on past reorganisations.

hiring.note: Nationality and cultural similarity to the leadership are never selection criteria. Culture analysis informs collaboration and onboarding only.

transformation.title: Five years of ownership, leadership and organisation resets

timeline.text: Ait Voncke becomes AVIV CEO; Caroline Evans de Gantès joins as MD of Groupe SeLoger.
De Gantès becomes AVIV CCO Europe for France, Germany and Belgium. SeLoger opens free listings to private sellers.
KKR/CPP deal signed. VP Operations Franck Le Tendre leaves. Capron arrives. Collective plan for 90 roles across 1,112 staff.
De Gantès leaves the CCO Europe role. Vladimir Pravdivy becomes AVIV CEO on 10 Mar.
KKR and CPP Investments take about 90% of AVIV; Axel Springer keeps 10%.
Voluntary-departure plan targeting 354 roles announced. My SeLoger Pro agent app launched at RENT.
PSE closes at 275 of 964 roles, ~80% engineering, as the pan-European platform ends. Stackler promoted to CTO.
Ad spend +30% and national TV campaign. Third court win against Jinka in seven months.
AI 'Recherche Intelligente' launched. Idealista enters France. Ouest-France Immo acquired.

metrics.title: Market cycle and headcount
metrics.note: 2024 transactions are derived from the company's +8.2% forecast for 2025. The 1,112 figure (l'Informé, Sep 2024) and the 964 figure (Jan 2026) may use different scopes. 689 is 964 minus 275, not a reported number.

businessInsights.title: Where SeLoger wins, where it is exposed

cards.title: Leader of the specialist niche, second to Leboncoin overall
cards.text: SeLoger claims leadership among 100%-real-estate portals and has over 33% of listings in Île-de-France. Leboncoin still has roughly double its traffic (42m vs ~21m monthly visits) and 70.6% of private-seller listings against SeLoger's 14.6%. All figures are third-party.

cards.title: The listings database is the moat, and it is defended in court
cards.text: Three rulings against aggregator Jinka (Dec 2025 to Jul 2026) rested on database-producer rights and misleading advertising: €60,000 damages and an order to stop scraping and delete data.

cards.title: Buying regional share rather than building it
cards.text: Ouest-France Immo (1.3m monthly visitors and 3.5m agency leads a year, company-reported) gives 75–80% of listings in three western regions. The brands stay separate and joint offers are due by end-2026.

cards.title: Growth is being bought with marketing and product
cards.text: Ad spend rises 30% in 2026, with a further 20% in marketing planned next year. AI search, My SeLoger Pro and 75+ planned innovations underpin a company-reported 1,500 new agency clients in H1 2025.

cards.title: No financial transparency
cards.text: No revenue, margin or churn figures exist for SeLoger or AVIV. The only number is the ~€10bn value of Axel Springer's whole classifieds business. Aggregator estimates disagree by orders of magnitude.

cards.title: Function-specific: commercial and tech roles inherit the hardest repairs
cards.text: Commercial leaders must rebuild agency trust and handle reported billing and cancellation disputes, turning sellers into performance consultants. Tech leaders inherit a team cut mostly in engineering and a platform handed back from AVIV.

competitors.edge: 42m monthly visits, 70.6% of private-seller listings, >1m listings
competitors.move: Also sued Jinka; trading audience claims with SeLoger and Bien'ici in 2026

competitors.model: Vertical portal backed by agency networks; map-centric, cheaper
competitors.move: Continued marketing and product investment to challenge SeLoger

competitors.model: Southern European portal (Spain, Italy, Portugal); ownership not researched
competitors.edge: Multi-country scale; led in France by ex-Leboncoin Immobilier exec Aurélien Flament
competitors.move: Launched in France on 10 Sep 2026, targeting individuals and professionals

competitors.edge: Owner-to-owner niche with no agency fees
'One app, all property sites' convenience for searchers
competitors.move: Lost three rulings in seven months; ordered to stop scraping SeLoger

vulnerability.title: Agency trust and proof of ROI
vulnerability.intro: Agencies pay the bills. The CEO says SeLoger drifted into managing clients 'from an open space' and talking only about subscription prices. A trade outlet reports billing and cancellation litigation with around twenty agencies, which is not corroborated by a primary source.

timeline.text: Free listings for private sellers widen the audience; positioning as the agencies' partner is tested.
Capron's first priorities: partnerships with professionals, qualified leads, sales presence beyond Paris.
My SeLoger Pro agent app launched after a 30-agent beta.
Trade press reports ~20 agency clients in billing and cancellation disputes and warns about churn.
Capron: sales re-regionalised, more regional events, salespeople to become consultants on performance.
Joint SeLoger–Ouest-France Immo offers due to western agencies.

vulnerability.note: Churn, litigation status and agency satisfaction are not published. Treat the dispute report as a hypothesis until the client confirms it.

conditions.title: PE owners with an undisclosed clock
conditions.facts: KKR and CPP Investments have held about 90% of AVIV since 29 Apr 2025, after a deal valuing Axel Springer's classifieds at ~€10bn. No exit horizon, board roster or return targets are public.
conditions.dayToDay: Expect owner-driven reporting through AVIV, short planning cycles and value milestones that France may not see first-hand. Results need to show in quarters, not years.
conditions.helps: A few hard metrics reported consistently, such as leads per euro, agency churn and release cadence, and early warning when a number will miss.
conditions.derails: Waiting for a published multi-year plan before committing, or presenting effort instead of results.

conditions.title: Decision rights moving from Berlin back to Paris
conditions.facts: AVIV built a shared listings platform and a CCO Europe role (2023–Jan 2025). In 2026 the platform project ended and France re-localised tech and product. Capron's reporting line into AVIV is not public.
conditions.dayToDay: Some decisions are newly French, others still sit with AVIV group functions, and the boundary is being drawn as you work.
conditions.helps: Writing down who decides what, testing it with AVIV counterparts and escalating rarely but clearly.
conditions.derails: Assuming the old group process still applies, or acting as if Paris now owns everything.

conditions.title: A thinner organisation after two job plans
conditions.facts: Staff fell from 1,112 (Sep 2024) through a 90-role plan to 964, then lost 275 more in 2026, ~80% in engineering. Glassdoor shows 2.6/5 for senior management and 55% would recommend the company.
conditions.dayToDay: Leaders run with fewer people, some lost know-how and wary teams. Every new initiative competes for the same remaining capacity.
conditions.helps: Ruthless prioritisation, visible stability and quick recognition of the people who stayed.
conditions.derails: Launching a fresh reorganisation, or planning on headcount that no longer exists.

conditions.title: French social dialogue sets the pace of change
conditions.facts: The 2026 PSE was negotiated for weeks with staff representatives and cut from 354 to 275 roles. Unions are quoted in press on leadership exits. Employees value intéressement, RTT and CSE benefits.
conditions.dayToDay: Changes to roles, organisation or working conditions run through information-consultation. Staff representatives are an informed counterpart.
conditions.helps: Early, reasoned dialogue with the CSE and timelines that include consultation.
conditions.derails: Announcing first and consulting later, or treating representatives as an obstacle.

conditions.title: Many brands, a stack in hand-over, a new acquisition
conditions.facts: Eight French brands and several pro packages and boosts run on one P&L. The shared AVIV platform ended in 2026, and Ouest-France Immo (with BellesPierres) joined on 1 Oct 2026 as a separate brand.
conditions.dayToDay: Every simplification touches live revenue, while a smaller tech team takes ownership of systems built for a group.
conditions.helps: Clear keep, merge or stop calls, sequenced so agencies keep receiving leads.
conditions.derails: Adding offers and brands without retiring any, or breaking the Rennes team during integration.

conditions.title: Agencies to win back, region by region
conditions.facts: Capron says SeLoger lost its 'merchant DNA'. Sales were re-regionalised, and app users in the provinces rose 30% (company-reported). Some agencies reportedly dispute billing and cancellations.
conditions.dayToDay: Every function is judged by how it feels to an agency outside Paris: invoices, product, support and data.
conditions.helps: Regular time with agencies and decisions explained in terms of their leads and costs.
conditions.derails: Running the function from the 9th arrondissement on dashboards alone.

conditions.title: A bigger rival, new entrants and a fragile cycle
conditions.facts: Leboncoin has about twice the traffic, Bien'ici grew 14% and Idealista launched on 10 Sep 2026. Transactions fell from 1.2m to 778k (2021–2023). Both France and AVIV have changed leaders since 2024.
conditions.dayToDay: Plans get reset by market data, competitor moves and political news; resource calls must be revisited often.
conditions.helps: Fast, evidence-based bets with explicit stop criteria and calm through the cycle.
conditions.derails: Defending last year's plan, or reacting to every rival claim.

environment.opportunity: The role-holder can help define what a 'local' SeLoger means in practice: which decisions sit in Paris rather than Berlin, how Ouest-France Immo is integrated, and how agencies measure the value they get.

unknowns: Revenue, margin, agency churn and France's share of AVIV results.
Who Capron reports to at AVIV, and which decisions need group or owner approval.
Owners' exit horizon, value-creation plan and AVIV board composition.
Post-PSE attrition, engagement and current hiring plans (careers page unreadable).
CMO and other France executive committee members' tenure and backgrounds.
hypotheses: Owner reporting runs on short cycles with value-creation milestones, as is typical of KKR-style ownership.
The reported agency billing disputes reflect broader churn pressure in the subscription base.
English remains the working language of AVIV group forums while France now works in French.
The job-ad ambition to 'capture 50% of France's residential GMV by 2030' reflects current strategy.
contradictions: Reason for the 2026 PSE: management cites the end of a pan-European project; Eurofound records a response to a national social crisis.
AVIV CEO: the register and press show Pravdivy since Mar 2025; a 2026 recruiter case study describes a new CEO search involving Ait Voncke.
Headcount: 1,112 (Sep 2024) vs 964 (Jan 2026) vs 530–684 on aggregators, likely different scopes.
Market tone: 'weaker than hoped' (Sep 2025 barometer) vs 'a real return to balance' (Oct 2025 interview).
Glassdoor still lists Caroline de Gantès as CEO; press confirms Capron. Reports also differ on whether she moved to CCO Europe in 2023 or Oct 2024.
confidence.sourcesNote: Sources accessed 9 Oct 2026. aviv-group.com, the AVIV pressroom and SeLoger's careers pages could not be read, so AVIV facts rely on press. Audience, client and traction figures are company-reported. Glassdoor data is indicative (tens to hundreds of reviews). The full URL of S15 was truncated in research; the outlet section is linked.

questions.question: What is the working language of the executive committee and of AVIV group forums?

questions.question: Who owns the Ouest-France Immo integration, and are further regional acquisitions planned?

questions.question: Is 'capture 50% of France's residential GMV by 2030' the current strategic goal?

skills.name: Delivering at KKR/CPP pace while France is still being redrawn
skills.definition: Producing visible results within months with the smaller, re-localised organisation, while running French consultation processes properly and keeping the owners' clock in view.
skills.whyHere: KKR and CPP took control of AVIV on 29 Apr 2025. France then completed a 275-of-964 job plan, ~80% in engineering, one year after cutting 90 roles. The same team must deliver 75+ planned innovations, absorb Ouest-France Immo and justify a 30% rise in ad spend. No exit horizon is public, so the pace has to be assumed rather than scheduled.

markers.title: Plans on the team that stayed
markers.text: Builds commitments on the ~689 people in post, not on the 964-person organisation chart.

markers.title: Commits in numbers
markers.text: Agrees a few measurable outcomes, such as leads per euro, churn and release cadence, and reports against them every cycle.

markers.title: Consultation on the critical path
markers.text: Schedules CSE information-consultation as part of delivery, as the 354-to-275 negotiation showed it changes outcomes.

markers.title: Closes what the last reorganisation opened
markers.text: Finishes or explicitly stops inherited projects instead of letting them drift.

evidence: Delivered results within 6–12 months of a 20%+ headcount reduction in their own area.
Worked under a PE or sponsor change of control with a value-creation plan and owner reviews.
Led or co-led a French PSE/RCC, or a comparable EU collective process, with documented outcomes.
redFlags: Treats staff-representative consultation as something to work around.
Describes success by the quality of the plan, not results delivered.
Needs a settled organisation before committing to targets.
skills.question: Tell me about a time you had to deliver a committed result within two quarters while your team was being cut or reorganised. What did you stop doing?
skills.probe: Which number would your owners or board have checked first, and what did you report when it slipped?
skills.confidenceNote: Inferred from ownership and restructuring facts. The owners' actual reporting cadence and milestones are unknown. Applies to any function; validate the reporting rhythm with AVIV.

skills.name: Leading French teams through a second cut in two years
skills.definition: Leading Paris and regional teams in a French business culture after two consecutive job plans, so that key people stay, engage and re-plan.
skills.whyHere: Staff went through a 90-role plan in 2024 and a 275-role PSE in 2026, negotiated with staff representatives. Glassdoor rates SeLoger senior management 2.6/5, and reviews cite 'constant change' and slow decisions. Capron now wants every team local and French-speaking.

markers.title: Reasoning before conclusions (Persuading)
markers.text: Explains the logic and the principle behind a decision before asking for action.

markers.title: Clear authority, reachable person (Leading)
markers.text: Decides visibly as the accountable leader while staying accessible on the floor and in the regions.

markers.title: Relationships before transactions (Trusting)
markers.text: Invests time with managers and staff representatives, so trust exists before the hard conversation.

markers.title: Welcomes challenge, then closes (Disagreeing)
markers.text: Invites open debate in management forums without reading it as disloyalty, then ends with a clear decision.

evidence: Led teams in France, or a similar business culture, through restructuring and kept named key people.
A working relationship with a CSE or works council that references from both sides describe as constructive.
References from French-speaking direct reports on how decisions were explained.
redFlags: Answers objections with 'the decision is made' and no reasoning.
Builds trust only through dashboards and email.
skills.question: Describe how you led a team after a significant layoff. What did you say in the first week, and how did you know whether people believed you?
skills.probe: Who pushed back hardest, and how did your relationship with them change?
skills.confidenceNote: Assessed in every candidate, French nationals included; it is a capability, never a proxy for nationality. The French language requirement must be validated with the client.

skills.name: Bridging Paris, Berlin and the owners without becoming a messenger
skills.definition: Representing France's needs in AVIV group forums and owner reviews in their format, and bringing back decisions that French teams understand and accept.
skills.whyHere: France reports into AVIV in Berlin, led since Mar 2025 by Vladimir Pravdivy, whose career was built at Avito. KKR and CPP sit above, and Axel Springer keeps 10% with Jan Bayer on AVIV's shareholder board. The 2026 re-localisation moved decisions to Paris, but Capron's reporting line and group sign-offs are not public. AVIV senior management rates 2.1/5 on Glassdoor.

markers.title: Brings the French case in group format
markers.text: Turns a local argument into the answer-first, data-led form an AVIV or investor review expects.

markers.title: Explains Berlin in Paris
markers.text: Tells French teams what the group decided and why, without hiding behind 'the group'.

markers.title: Maps the new boundary
markers.text: Writes down which decisions are now local since 2026 and tests the map with group counterparts.

markers.title: One message in every room
markers.text: Says the same thing to owners, group and French teams, adjusting only the format.

evidence: Ran a country unit or function inside a foreign-headquartered group and changed an HQ decision.
References from both a headquarters or owner-side stakeholder and a local team member.
Worked productively in both French and English settings.
redFlags: Blames 'Berlin' or 'the owners' for unpopular decisions.
Fully takes one side and loses credibility with the other.
Escalates every disagreement to the group.
skills.question: Tell me about a time you needed a headquarters or owner decision changed for your local business. How did you make the case, and what came back?
skills.probe: How did you explain the outcome to your local team when you did not get what you asked for?
skills.confidenceNote: Decision rights after the 2026 re-localisation are unknown. Weight rises if many sign-offs remain with AVIV or the owners.

skills.name: Running your function as close to the agencies as sales now is
skills.definition: Using the experience of the 20,000 partner agencies, including those outside Paris, as the test for decisions in every function: finance, tech, product, people and marketing.
skills.whyHere: Capron says SeLoger lost its 'ADN de commerçant' and managed clients 'from an open space'. He re-regionalised sales and wants consultants talking performance. App users in the provinces are up 30% and 1,500 agencies were added in H1 2025 (company-reported). Some agencies reportedly dispute billing and cancellations, and Ouest-France Immo was bought for regional roots.

markers.title: Shows up in the regions
markers.text: Spends regular time with agencies outside Paris, including the newly acquired western markets.

markers.title: Speaks in agency ROI
markers.text: Explains the effect of a decision on an agency's leads, costs or workload.

markers.title: Fixes the irritant behind the complaint
markers.text: Traces agency complaints, such as a billing or cancellation issue, to the process that caused them and changes it.

markers.title: Lets field evidence overrule the dashboard
markers.text: Changes course when agency feedback contradicts internal metrics.

evidence: Led a function serving many small B2B customers, with measurable retention or satisfaction gains.
Redesigned a customer-facing process (billing, onboarding, support, product) after complaints.
Ran pilots with real users before rollout, as My SeLoger Pro did with 30 agents.
redFlags: Cannot name a customer conversation from the last quarter.
Treats customer proximity as the sales team's job.
Measures success only on internal efficiency.
skills.question: Give an example of a decision in your function that you changed because of what customers told you directly. How did you hear it?
skills.probe: What did the change cost internally, and how did you measure whether customers noticed?
skills.confidenceNote: The scale of agency dissatisfaction is unconfirmed; the litigation report is a hypothesis. For non-commercial roles, validate how much direct agency contact is expected.

skills.name: Simplifying a multi-brand estate while absorbing Ouest-France Immo
skills.definition: Deciding what to merge, keep separate or stop across brands, offers and systems, while the tech stack moves from AVIV's shared platform to a smaller French team and the business keeps selling.
skills.whyHere: One P&L carries SeLoger, SeLoger Neuf, SeLoger Construire, SeLoger Bureaux & Commerces, Meilleurs Agents, Logic-Immo, Belles Demeures and Lux Résidence. It also carries five core packages plus boosts such as Duo Prime and Top Position. The pan-European platform ended in 2026 after engineering cuts. Ouest-France Immo and BellesPierres arrived on 1 Oct 2026, kept as a separate brand with joint offers due by end-2026.

markers.title: Keep, merge or stop with a reason
markers.text: Makes explicit portfolio calls tied to agency value and cost, rather than letting offers accumulate.

markers.title: Owns the inherited platform
markers.text: Takes responsibility for systems built for a group, including their debts, instead of waiting for Berlin.

markers.title: Integrates without breaking what was bought
markers.text: Protects the 35-person Rennes team and its regional agency relationships during integration.

markers.title: Keeps the leads flowing
markers.text: Sequences changes so agencies never see a drop in service.

evidence: Rationalised brands, products or systems in a live business with no revenue disruption.
Integrated an acquired company while retaining its key people and customers.
Took over a platform or shared service from a group function.
redFlags: Adds new offers without retiring old ones.
Runs integration as a pure cost exercise.
Underestimates the work hidden in inherited group systems.
skills.question: Tell me about a time you simplified a portfolio of products, brands or systems while revenue depended on them. What did you cut, and what did you protect?
skills.probe: What broke that you did not expect, and how did customers find out?
skills.confidenceNote: Integration ownership and remaining AVIV platform dependencies are unknown. Weight is higher for tech, product, finance and marketing roles.

skills.name: Competing for agency budgets against Leboncoin, Bien'ici and Idealista
skills.definition: Making fast, evidence-based resource calls in a market where SeLoger leads the specialist niche but trails a much larger rival, new entrants arrive and AI changes search.
skills.whyHere: Leboncoin has ~42m monthly visits to SeLoger's ~21m and 70.6% of private-seller listings to 14.6%. Bien'ici reported 220m visits in 2025 (+14%). Idealista launched on 10 Sep 2026, and Jinka lost three rulings. Transactions fell from 1.2m to 778k (2021–2023). SeLoger answered with AI search, +30% ad spend and an acquisition, while flagging political and housing-policy risk.

markers.title: Reads the market, not just the plan
markers.text: Tracks competitor moves, transaction volumes and agency budgets, and adjusts priorities when they shift.

markers.title: Bets with exit criteria
markers.text: Funds initiatives such as AI search or marketing pushes with explicit success and stop thresholds.

markers.title: Protects the moat
markers.text: Treats the listings database, lead quality and agency relationships as assets to defend in their own function.

markers.title: Steady through the cycle
markers.text: Avoids overreacting to rival audience claims or a single weak quarter.

evidence: Competed as number two or challenger against a larger platform and won share in a segment.
Reallocated budget or people mid-year in response to market data, with results.
Managed through a cyclical downturn in a transaction-linked market.
redFlags: Defends last year's plan despite new data.
Copies competitor moves without a thesis.
Cannot quantify the impact of past bets.
skills.question: Describe a moment when a competitor's move or a market shift forced you to change priorities mid-year. What did you stop funding?
skills.probe: How did you decide the threat was real and not noise?
skills.confidenceNote: Competitive data is third-party or company-reported. If the client confirms the 50%-of-GMV ambition, this capability may move up for strategy and commercial roles.

Bien'ici 220m visits in 2025 (+14%); Idealista launched in France 10 Sep 2026
Three rulings against Jinka Dec 2025 to Jul 2026 on database rights and misleading advertising
Ouest-France Immo 100% acquired 1 Oct 2026; 75–80% regional listings; brands kept; 35 Rennes staff
Product push: AI search (Sep 2026), My SeLoger Pro (Nov 2025), Duo Prime, Top Position, 75+ innovations
